name: com.freesleeperr.insidestage
description: 用于实现类型inside渲染效果的工具包，Volumetric fog integrated into URP's volume system. Supports additional lights, shadows and cookies, as well as animated 3D noise to render cloud alike fog. Render graph support is available for Unity 6 and above.

samples.description: Complete InsideStage scene with lighting, materials, URP settings and volumetric fog setup.
